benefits.titleEn: It Emphasises Sudden and Complete Change
benefits.titleZh: 突出突然及徹底的改變
benefits.en: The idiomatic version makes it clear that she stopped completely and did not reduce her use gradually.
benefits.zh: 慣用語版本清楚表示她立即完全停用社交媒體，而不是逐步減少。

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Clear Contrast with “Cut Down”
benefits.titleZh: 與 cut down 形成清楚對比
benefits.zh: 逐步減少突然完全停止沒有一下子戒掉咖啡，而是每次少喝一杯。

examples.en: Rather than go cold turkey on coffee, Priya cut down one cup at a time.
examples.zh: 沒有一下子戒掉咖啡，而是每次少喝一杯。

benefits.titleEn: It Describes a Strong Decision Concisely
benefits.titleZh: 簡潔描述一個需要決心的決定
benefits.en: He decided to go cold turkey on the app.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語可以把「決定立即完全停止」濃縮成一個自然的表達。

benefits.en: statements; questions; negative sentences; modal structures; perfect tenses; conditional sentences; reported speech; gerund clauses; infinitive clauses.
benefits.zh: 學生不只需要記住 went cold turkey，也應掌握 go、goes、gone 和 going 等不同形式。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful Beyond Substance-Related Contexts
benefits.en: It Is Useful Beyond Substance-Related Contexts

benefits.titleEn: It Is Not Automatically Better Than Plain English
benefits.titleZh: 並非一定比普通表達更好
benefits.en: If the method of stopping is unimportant, simply saying stop may be clearer.
benefits.zh: 只有當「突然」和「完全」是重要意思時，才需要使用 go cold turkey。

history.zh: 來源有爭議； 確切演變過程不明

history.en: Cold turkey was used before it became strongly connected with stopping addictive substances. Merriam-Webster reports an example from 1910 in which cold turkey meant doing something outright, while a 1920 newspaper cartoon used it in the sense of speaking plainly. A drug-withdrawal use is documented by 1921.
history.zh: cold turkey 在與戒除成癮物質產生密切聯繫之前，已有其他用法。 Merriam-Webster 指出，1910 年的例子中，cold turkey 表示直接或徹底地做某事； 1920年的報章漫畫則把它用於坦率說話。 到了1921年，已有與突然戒除毒品相關的書面記錄。

origin.memoryEn: Think of one immediate, complete break: no gradual reduction and no middle stage.
origin.memoryZh: 把它想像成一次即時而徹底的中斷：沒有逐步減少，也沒有中間階段。
